faq.q: Why does my dryer run but not heat?
faq.a: On electric dryers it is usually the element, thermal fuse or a thermostat; on gas dryers the igniter or gas valve coils.

faq.q: Is a burning smell from my dryer dangerous?
faq.a: It can be, so stop using the dryer, unplug it and call us; lint near the heat source is a common cause.
Yes. We repair both gas and electric dryers.

faq.q: How long does a dryer repair take?
faq.a: Most dryer repairs take about an hour on site.

faq.q: Can a clogged vent damage my dryer?
faq.a: Yes. Poor airflow overheats the dryer and blows its safety fuse, which is why we check the vent.
